requirements.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:33-61 covers no-op on blank URL (`blank($url)`), POST JSON `['content' => $content]` with `Http::timeout(5)`, title/message/`key=value` lines, `mb_substr(..., 0, self::MAX_LENGTH)` with MAX_LENGTH 1800, key-based redaction regex `/password|token|secret|authorization|api[_-]?key|webhook/i` (line 22), bearer redaction (line 24, 84), recursive redaction rendered as JSON (lines 69-79, 90), non-2xx and Throwable logged at error level with the URL and its path scrubbed (lines 52-59, 101-107). config/logging.php:76-83 adds the audit channel (daily, logs/audit.log, level env LOG_AUDIT_LEVEL 'info', days env LOG_AUDIT_DAYS 90); stack default is 'daily' (line 57); there is no discord channel. config/services.php:39-41 adds the webhook config; .env.example and phpunit.xml:29 pin LOG_STACK=daily. The daily channel itself is not touched in the diff; LoggingChannelsTest.php:38-42 asserts the existing default `days` of 14.

conventions.evidence: The task explicitly asks for a plain service class in app/Ops, so this does not break the 'no service layers' rule. Docs are kept in sync: new docs/ops/logging.md with a decision guide, README.md doc table row, CHANGELOG.md entries under Added/Changed, a cross-link in docs/ops/devops.md:30. Public `send()` has PHPDoc (lines 26-32). Pest tests are under tests/Feature. No Livewire, migration or UI conventions apply.

security.evidence: The webhook URL is never logged: `scrub()` removes both the full URL and its path, which carries the token (lines 101-107). The non-2xx log contains only `status`. Secrets are redacted by key, and bearer tokens are redacted in values, title and message. `JSON_INVALID_UTF8_SUBSTITUTE` keeps json_encode from failing. services.php comments warn not to log the URL. No weakness found.

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/Ops/DiscordOpsAlertTest.php covers: resolution from the container; no-op for null and '' (dataset); exact POST URL, JSON header and content; line format including bool and null values; exact 1800-character multibyte truncation; every sensitive-key variant, case-insensitive; bearer in values and in the message; nested JSON redaction; a 429 error log without the URL; a transport failure with the URL scrubbed. tests/Feature/Logging/LoggingChannelsTest.php covers the stack pin, the LOG_STACK default when unset, daily/audit config, a real audit write that drops debug, and the absence of a discord channel.

simplicity.evidence: Small, direct class (108 lines) using Laravel's Http and Log facades and `blank()`. Some extras go beyond what was asked: the `render()` match handles `Stringable` and `get_debug_type` cases (lines 92-99), and `->asJson()` is redundant because `post()` already sends JSON by default (line 51).

readability.evidence: Named constants (MAX_LENGTH, REDACTED, SENSITIVE_KEY, BEARER), small private helpers with clear names (redactValue, redactText, render, scrub), a class docblock that explains intent. No dead code or debug output.

scope.evidence: Every changed file serves the task: notifier, logging/services config, .env.example, phpunit.xml, docs (logging.md, README row, CHANGELOG, a one-line devops.md cross-link) and tests. The notifier is not wired into any job or handler, which matches the out-of-scope section.

issues.explanation: The diff relies on the existing `daily` channel already using `env('LOG_DAILY_DAYS', 14)` and laravel.log; this is not visible in the diff and is only covered by the test at tests/Feature/Logging/LoggingChannelsTest.php:38-42.
`->asJson()` is redundant because Laravel's HTTP client `post()` sends JSON by default.
`render()` handles Stringable objects and debug types, which the task does not require; slightly more code than the minimum.
The LOG_STACK-default test changes process env globals (putenv, $_ENV, $_SERVER) and re-requires the config file; this works but is fragile compared with a plain config assertion.

review.summary: The change adds App\Ops\DiscordOpsAlert with a no-op when unconfigured, 1800-character multibyte truncation, key- and bearer-based recursive redaction, and soft-fail error logging that scrubs the webhook URL. It also adds the audit channel, switches the stack default to daily, pins LOG_STACK in phpunit.xml and env examples, and documents the three lanes. Tests are thorough and cover every requirement and failure path. Only minor nits remain (a redundant asJson, slightly extra rendering logic, a fragile env-manipulating test), so I would approve with nits.
